title: Change of Registrant and Contact Verification — Domain Registrations
content:
## Compliance policy — change of registrant and registrant verification (Domain Registrations)

**C1.** A change of registrant may be made only while the domain status is active.

**C2.** A change of registrant may be made only while no registry lock is in force on the domain.

**C3.** Where the TLD's change-of-registrant lock days are above 0, the change starts a transfer lock of that many days, unless the registrant opts out at the time of the change and the TLD allows the opt-out. An opt-out cannot be added afterwards.

**C4.** Where the TLD's registrant verification days are above 0, a new registration or a change of registrant must be confirmed through the verification email within that many calendar days of the registration or change date. Where the TLD suspends unverified domains, a domain still unverified after the last day is placed on registrar hold the next day.

**C5.** Confirming the verification email at any time marks the registrant verified and lifts a registrar hold the same day. A hold never changes the expiry date or any renewal deadline.

**C6.** The change of registrant is requested by the current registrant, and the new registrant's name and organisation are recorded verbatim as given.

### Basis

C1 and C2 rest on the system record of the domain holding (its status and its registry lock) read before the change. C6 rests on the request of the current registrant; the new name and organisation are taken as the registrant gives them.

### C3 combinations

| TLD lock days | TLD allows opt-out | Registrant opts out at the change | Transfer lock started |
|---|---|---|---|
| above 0 | Yes | yes | no |
| above 0 | Yes | no | yes |
| above 0 | No | (opt-out not available) | yes |
| 0 | — | — | no |

### Hypothetical verification timeline (invented dates, 15-day requirement)

A change of registrant on 2 April 2029 must be confirmed by 17 April 2029. If the TLD suspends unverified domains and no confirmation has arrived by then, the domain goes on registrar hold on 18 April 2029; a confirmation on 25 April 2029 lifts the hold that same day, and the expiry date is unchanged throughout.
